$comment: Known-good headless invocations per coding harness, taken from svc scripts that run them today (see each 'source'). Placeholders: {model} {effort} {prompt_file} {cwd} {schema_file} {schema_json} {out_file}. 'probe' lists flags scripts/harness-playbook.mjs verify checks against the installed CLI's --help, so a CLI upgrade that renames a flag is caught before a run. Host install paths and hook quirks live in provision/hosts/<host>.json. Refresh this file when a probe fails or a release note renames a flag; never add a flag that no script or official doc has shown working. A host with 'launcher' runs through that wrapper; its role flags belong to the wrapper. probe.documented_hidden lists flags the official docs show but --help omits; verify does not probe them. Every host under provision/hosts/ has exactly one entry, matched by 'provision_host' (agy is the reviewer-transport id of the antigravity host). An entry with empty 'roles' has no headless invocation svc runs today; it carries 'no_headless_reason' instead of a probe, and verify skips it.

reference_prompt.why: The shape the external-review launcher sends to every host (scripts/run-external-review.mjs). It works across families because it states role, mode, inputs, the exact output contract and the stop condition, and nothing else.
reference_prompt.template:
You are the {role} for {task}. Work {mode}.
Inputs: {inputs}.
Done means: {done_condition}.
Return exactly one raw JSON object matching this schema, with no markdown or commentary:
{schema_json}
rules: One role and one task per prompt; put long context in files the agent reads, not in the prompt.
Say read-only or write-allowed explicitly and pass the matching CLI permission flag; the prompt alone is not a sandbox.
Give a machine-checkable output contract (JSON schema) and validate it after transport, fail-closed.
State the stop condition; cap turns or budget with the CLI flag when one exists.
Never put secrets or session identifiers in argv; pass prompts by stdin or prompt file.

claude.name: Claude Code
claude.notes: Inside Claude Code itself prefer native subagents (Agent tool with model/effort) and saved workflows over shelling out; see scripts/route-model.mjs.

codex.name: OpenAI Codex CLI
codex.notes: Effort is a config override (-c model_reasoning_effort=...), not a flag. Hooks need the hooks feature flag in ~/.codex/config.toml. The review role runs in the read-only sandbox so a reviewer cannot write; never add a sandbox-bypass flag to a review role. (test-framework/tests/harness-playbook-review-sandbox.test.mjs)

agy.name: Antigravity / Gemini via the agy dispatcher
agy.notes: Reviewer transport only: svc refuses agy as orchestrator or PLAN/EXEC host (scripts/resolve-dispatch.mjs:518). The model preset name must encode the effort (scripts/review-topology-v2.mjs:55). The roles are the dispatcher's flags; the probe checks the agy CLI flags the dispatcher relies on.

grok.name: Grok Build CLI
grok.conflict: The exec form passes --effort while the probed review form passes --reasoning-effort. Only --reasoning-effort is verified by a --help probe; check `grok --help` before relying on the exec form.

cursor.name: Cursor CLI
cursor.notes: Hooks block by exit code 2, not JSON; no regex matchers (provision/hosts/cursor.json).

kimi.name: Kimi Code CLI
kimi.notes: Not an allowed reviewer (CLAUDE.md reviewer allowlist). Long prompts as an argument hit argv limits; keep them short or use a detached runner (scripts/run-kimi-detached.sh).

opencode.name: OpenCode CLI
opencode.notes: Token usage lines vary by version (scripts/dispatch-log.sh:13).

gemini.name: Gemini CLI
gemini.prompt_delivery: none: svc runs no headless Gemini CLI call
gemini.no_headless_reason: svc removed Gemini CLI inference (scripts/spine-research.mjs:46 refuses --agent gemini). Google-family reviews go through the agy entry, and the host is provisioned for skills, hooks, MCP, commands and agents only (provision/hosts/gemini.json, no plugins).
gemini.notes: Hooks are wired by scripts/wire-gemini-hooks.mjs with millisecond timeouts (outer 30000). Add a role only once a script runs `gemini` headless and a probe covers its flags.

mimo-code.name: MiMo Code
mimo-code.prompt_delivery: none: svc runs no headless MiMo Code call
mimo-code.no_headless_reason: MiMo Code is an OpenCode fork that shares the OpenCode plugin (scripts/wire-opencode-hooks.mjs --host mimo-code, config ~/.config/mimocode/mimocode.json). No svc script runs `mimocode` headless and the CLI's run flags are unverified (docs/specs/research/large-review-input-harness-assessment-20260915.md), so the opencode exec role is not assumed to carry over. MiMo execution runs through the opencode entry with a mimo/<model> provider.
mimo-code.notes: Not an allowed reviewer (CLAUDE.md reviewer allowlist). The plugin is observational; mutating child execution is off (provision/hosts/mimo-code.json authority_capabilities).
